spans.s: Short name for the musical note षड्ज q. v.
(In prosody) A foot consisting of two short syllables followed by a long one.

A prefix substituted for सह or सम्, सम, तुल्य,
 or सदृश and एक or समान, and compounded with nouns to
 form adjectives and adverbs in the sense of
——(a) with, together with, along with, accompanied by, having, possessed
 of; सपुत्र, सभार्य, सतृष्ण, सधन, सरोषम्, सकोपम्, सहरि &c.;
——(b) similar, like; सधर्मन् ‘of a similar nature’; so सजाति, सवर्ण;
——(c) same; सोदर, सपक्ष, सपिण्ड, सनाभि &c. ━m.
